command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -v test_hpi_delta_full_spherical_2026.py && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 hpi_delta_full_spherical_2026.py

mathematics.assertion_tested: For the displayed HPI-Delta action, retaining and varying the full static spherical lapse, radial shift, two spatial metric functions, and multiplier derives an auxiliary-flat isolated branch; on that branch a classical positive-density center requires 4*pi*G*(rho_0+3*p_c)=Lambda, while the attractive Puiseux branch has R4~5*c/sqrt(r) and Kretschmann~43*c^2/r.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic real arithmetic; N>0, A>0, R>0 for r>0, ell_0>0, G>0, c>0 on the attractive one-sided radial branch.
mathematics.conventions: ADM signature (-,+,+,+), K_ij=(dot(h)_ij-L_beta h_ij)/(2N), T=t, q=D^2(lambda), the speed of light is set to one in the relativistic equations, and matter source normalizations E_N/(A R^2)=16*pi*G*rho and E_A/(2N)=-8*pi*G*p_r*R^2.
inputs: unitary-clock spherical ADM ansatz with N, beta, A, R, and lambda retained
regular-center and asymptotically static isolated boundary conditions

bounds.symmetry: static spherical sector; time-dependent spherical extrinsic-curvature convention stated but not fully varied
bounds.matter: zero radial momentum, continuous central rho and pressure, p_r(0)=p_t(0)
bounds.center: exact Taylor jets sufficient through the first finite smooth and Puiseux coefficients
bounds.boundary: no central lambda point charge, finite auxiliary action, asymptotically static isolated branch

non_claims: No full nonlinear functional Dirac theorem.
No boosted PPN coefficients or global stability result.
No exclusion of a cosmological constant-mean-curvature branch.
No global literature-novelty claim and no completed relativistic MOND theory.

checks: direct higher-Euler variation reproduces the factored lambda and radial-shift equations

direct N, A, and R variations reproduce three independently stated geometric equations, while all full barred-kinetic metric variations vanish only after the derived auxiliary-flat branch is substituted
raw curvature action differs from the first-order action only by the derived boundary term
radial-diffeomorphism identity vanishes in both metric and barred-kinetic sectors
direct Christoffel/Riemann engine produces the Ricci and Kretschmann center coefficients
Minkowski, Schwarzschild, unit-three-sphere, and static-de-Sitter controls pass
GR, positive-mu(0), wrong-laplacian, wrong-b-square, premature-shift, and singular-flux mutations are live
11/11 adversarial unit tests and 13/13 executable certificate predicates pass
residual_risks: The covariant clock completion still lacks a full nonlinear Dirac proof.
A cosmological CMC or nonspherical external-field branch is outside the tested family.
A singular central auxiliary charge or nonclassical weak metric leaves the stated regularity class.
The symbolic computation verifies finite center jets; it is not a global boundary-value existence proof.
